title: Tacos al Pastor
description: A Mexican-inspired dish featuring marinated pork cooked on a rotisserie, served in tacos with onions, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine orange juice, lime juice, ginger, garlic, and 1 teaspoon salt. Blend until smooth.
Add the pork to a large zip-top plastic bag. Pour the marinade over the pork and massage to coat. Seal the bag and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.

Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the pork from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off. Cook the pork for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes. Slice the pork into thin strips.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of pork onto a tortilla, followed by some sliced onion, cilantro, and a sprinkle of queso fresco. Serve with salsa on the side.
